messages.campaign_fixture.quest.dragon.title: Campaign fixture: the dragon
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.dragon.descriptio: Observe an ordinary Ender Dragon defeat, including one that happened before this quest began.
campaign_fixture.quest.dragon.offer.line: This is a campaign test. The shared record is permanent for this world. Each player keeps their own progress.
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.dragon.response.w: I will return after the dragon falls.
campaign_fixture.quest.dragon.watch.line: Defeat the Ender Dragon through ordinary Minecraft gameplay. The campaign observes the world result. It cannot infer who took part.
